eos_records.label: Cynn and Yoo (1999)
eos_records.reference: Cynn and Yoo, Phys. Rev. B 59, 8526-8529 (1999), doi:10.1103/PhysRevB.59.8526
eos_records.notes: Cynn and Yoo report K0 = 194.7(4.8) GPa and K0' = 3.4(1). V0 is retained from the ambient bcc lattice because the fit uncertainty was not tabulated.

eos_records.reference: Shen and Smith, Phys. Rev. B 113, 144113 (2026), doi:10.1103/fxgq-96sg
eos_records.notes: Table II Cu-referenced fit using DAC-1 data; DAC-2 was excluded and V0 was fixed. Reported uncertainties: K0 +/- 0.4 GPa and K0' +/- 0.02.
